root.label: Taylor Farms announces 2027 Mexico iceberg lettuce sales suspension

events.label: Taylor Farms announces 2027 Mexico iceberg lettuce sales suspension

slots.name: suspension status
slots.sentence: Taylor Farms, the produce giant linked to last summer’s deadly cyclospora outbreak, is suspending sales of iceberg lettuce from central Mexico during the parasite’s peak season.

slots.name: suspension lift date
slots.sentence: The company hasn’t determined when the suspension will be lifted.

slots.name: suspension start date
slots.sentence: Taylor Farms suspended sourcing and production of iceberg lettuce from central Mexico in July.

slots.name: facility status
slots.sentence: The company said its processing facility in the region remains closed.
